postprocess_name: Agent辅助场景审核与后处理
goal: Plausible and sufficiently complete scene assets at observed building locations, allowing connected architectural groups and minor boundary intersections.
review_inputs: completed reference images and actual generated model front/back views
existing scene bindings and actual mesh intersection reports
optional reference data, explicitly declared when used

model_actions.retain_existing_model: Keep the verified existing model and placement.
model_actions.regenerate_from_cached_image: Reuse a reviewed complete appearance image, run standard three-stage generation and fit the resulting actual model.
model_actions.regenerate_image_and_model: Complete a defective appearance reference first, review it, then generate and place its model.

assembly_actions: Group connected building parts with explicit source membership.
Record and review physical boundary or group seam intersections.
Disable obsolete or visibly floating surface attachments by default, retaining their models and evidence.
Review each proposed massing component separately; rejecting a narrow patch does not reject valid members of the same source group.
review_outputs: source ID and source file identity
action, reason and whether reference data influenced review
published observation/image/model evidence and file identities
accepted model metadata, placement and group membership
per-component retain/omit reason, donor model identities, target geometry, height, transform and actual scene evidence

new_input_policy.generation: Use the current structure and explicitly mapped completed image; never substitute the provided asset cache for requested new inference.
partial_sources: If an independent building or connected group is supported, complete its image and generate that building or group.
If the observation belongs to a missing podium or wing, generate an appropriate part or explicitly approve reuse of existing donor parts.
If current geometry already covers the source, record its relationship without duplicate placement.
If evidence remains insufficient, preserve the source and the reason; do not automatically fill it with an arbitrary building.
new_input_policy.massing_reuse: Optional separately reviewed scene operation after inspecting actual generated models. Missing source-mask coverage alone is not sufficient evidence to place a building. The example recipe is valid only for its frozen source, donors, placement and scene identities.
new_input_policy.lods: Review all requested 0.1M/0.25M/1M outputs. A repair to the standard pair does not approve or repair the optional 1M mesh.
new_input_policy.automation_boundary: The program prepares evidence and replays explicit decisions; a generated report or template is not an Agent approval. Generation/finalize does not automatically run a general Agent or create a new massing recipe.

scene_postprocess.default_evidence: Use original observations, recovered source structure, completed images and actual current model meshes/placements. GT is not a default input or a rule for copying missing geometry.
candidate_rules: Confirm visible roof/facade or other coherent building-body evidence; a road, shadow, isolated edge or unexplained mask gap is not a building candidate.
Inspect source ownership and observed height/layer before treating a roof fragment as a whole ground-to-roof building.
Compare actual registered model triangles with the observed source in XY and height. Already occupied locations get an association record, not duplicate placement.
Only propose missing building bodies supported by the observations; do not optimize source-mask coverage to 100%.
Prefer completing an appropriate image and generating the building/part when its form is supported. Existing donor reuse is an explicit alternative, not an automatic fallback.

component_review.unit: Individual proposed model component with a stable ID, not the whole source group.
component_review.size_screen: Width, footprint area, aspect ratio, height and scale distortion identify candidates needing review. Example thresholds are not universal architectural rules and do not by themselves authorize deletion.
component_review.retain: Keep a coherent and plausibly placed body even if it is below a screening threshold, with an explicit part-bound decision and actual model/scene evidence.
component_review.omit: Remove an implausibly tiny/narrow filler, excessive deformation, unsupported body, road obstruction or major duplicate/core collision; preserve valid siblings and allow uncovered gaps.
component_review.group_exclusion: Cancel all components only through an explicit whole-source decision with its own reason/evidence. In the shipped scene only 232/330/404/573 were explicitly cancelled as groups; other empty groups follow individual omissions.
component_review.insufficient_evidence: Keep the source and unresolved reason, optionally preserving disabled observation surfaces. Do not fill it with an arbitrary building.

implementation.model_evidence: batch_review.review_models creates actual LOD views and scene_intersections.json; its report and templates do not approve models.
implementation.repairs: batch_delivery reads source- and mesh-bound reviews/repairs.json, applies supported CPU repairs, then validates the current candidates again.
implementation.massing_candidate: massing_completion.construct_manifest, measure_manifest and render_review build an explicit candidate and actual geometry/context evidence. Candidate authoring and semantic review require an Agent or human.
implementation.part_selection: massing_completion.prune_recipe records decisions and invalidates old scene approval. policy.part_reviews binds a component decision to its donor/source/target/transform identity.
implementation.frozen_replay: massing_completion.apply_recipe and validate_massing check the selected baseline, donor files, placements, support files and review evidence. apply_recipe requires its explicit baseline/cache contract; it is not an automatic new-scene discovery command.

freeze_requirements: Original source identity, baseline binding and all donor/output mesh hashes.
Per-component target polygon, base/top height, world transform, retain/omit reason and reviewer.
Actual geometry/height/intersection checks and before/after context images for the current scene.
Explicit approval after evidence review; changed images, meshes, transforms, source membership or relevant scene context require renewed review.
scene_postprocess.validation_scope: Actual-mesh XY projections and height/intersection checks are useful screens, not a closed-solid physics simulation or proof of true building identity. Review all requested LODs; the shipped dual-LOD massing implementation does not automatically approve a new 1M part.

execution: Prepare and review the complete batch before GPU generation. Execute explicit appearance/generation steps as needed, then replay frozen decisions using published caches. Replay itself never calls APIs or requests GPUs.
reproducibility: Frozen data decisions and cached artifacts replay exactly. Agent reasoning and remote image generation are not claimed to be deterministic on new inputs.
reference_disclosure: The published SmallCity review used GT/rendered XYZ as existence, ownership and diagnostic references. Reference geometry and heights were not copied into generated/placed assets. Curated scene quality is not an independent test-set performance claim.
